purpose: The routes overflow-audit.js loads, by the build it measures. CI-only: never served. `docs` is the composed build abcdev.app serves, narrowed to its documentation; `record` is the project route's build of abcd's record, as GitHub Pages serves it. Each route is a page that build writes, which internal/core/site's audit tests check against real builds. `sample` names the export the audit reads and the record types it samples two pages of.
